descriptor: Woman, 41, Southern Californian, mid-length dark hair pushed back or loosely tied, minimal or no makeup, fine lines she has not hidden, plain crew-neck tee or soft knit in neutral tones. Warm skin, natural texture, never retouched. Ordinary and specific.
